sections.Profile:
Ice-Revue and Ice Show are two electro-mechanical pinball machines produced by D. Gottlieb & Co. in the mid-1960s. Ice-Revue , released in December 1965, is the replay version, while Ice Show , produced in early 1966, is the add-a-ball variant. Both machines were designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Roy Parker, featuring an ice-skating theme.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1965–1966
